fixed_skill.desc:
Deal Curse damage to all foes equal to 150.0%/157.5%/165.0% of Attack.
Increase all foes' damage taken by 12.0%/12.6%/13.2%, and also, when taking an attack from a Sweeper ally, increase critical damage taken by 10.0%/10.5%/11.0%. Lasts for 3 turns.
fixed_skill.name: Sepulchral Scythe

innate_skill.desc: Deal Curse damage to all foes equal to 45.0/49.3/53.6% of Attack. Low chance to deal Curse insta-kill effect to foes with 50% or less HP. Increase chance based on foe's lost HP.
innate_skill.name: Mamudoon

innate_skill.desc: Deal Physical damage to 1 foe equal to 56.7/59.5/62.4% of Attack (2 to 3 hits).
innate_skill.name: Myriad Slashes

passive_skill.desc:
Increase Attack by 29.1%.
At the start of battle, gain 3 Morbidity stacks. Gain 1 Morbidity stack when any ally deals damage with a skill. Morbidity stacks up to 3 times. These effects activate even in reserve.
When the user targets a foe with a skill, increase all foes' critical damage taken by 15% for 3 turns. At that time, spend 3 Morbidity stacks, and for 3 turns, when the target takes damage from a Sweeper ally, increase final damage taken amplification by 1.5%.
passive_skill.name: Danse Macabre
